facts.fact: SAnews, citing Operation Vulindlela's 2026 Q2 progress report, says the MzansiXchange data-sharing pilot is progressing towards completion in December 2026.

ZAF.note: MyMzansi is a prototype in a controlled testing environment and Gov.za is operational for departmental testing only; no service is stated launched or available to users.
The document states no interoperability framework.
The document states no law or decree on public bodies sharing data.
The document states no technical standards for government systems.
